phase: PHASE 3: LIVE EXAM ENGINE — EVERY INTERACTIVE FUNCTIONALITY
title: Question Payload & Data Schema

payload_architecture.load_mechanism: Pre-rendered or JSON-hydrated on page load into global execution context (or retrieved via GET /exams/tests/p/load.cgi?c={c}&testid={id})

global_variables_injected.pauseSet: String ('0' = fresh test, '1' = resume existing attempt)
global_variables_injected.totalTime: String seconds (e.g. '1200' = 20 min per section, '3600' = 60 min total)
global_variables_injected.timeTotal: String human readable (e.g. '20 Minutes' or '60 Minutes')
global_variables_injected.noOption: String number of options per question (typically '5' for banking, '4' for SSC/regulatory)
global_variables_injected.secList: Array<String> section display names: ['English Language', 'Quantitative Aptitude', 'Reasoning Ability']
global_variables_injected.nq: Integer total questions in active section or test (e.g. 40)
global_variables_injected.lastQid: Integer last question database ID (firstQid + nq - 1)

hasPassage.description: If true, renders 2-pane split; if false, renders single-pane MCQ

passageHTML.description: Full HTML markup of comprehension passage, RC, or DI directions

questionHTML.description: Full HTML markup of the question statement

text.description: Plain text extraction of option content

correct_answer.description: Correct option letter ('A'-'E') for solutions / evaluation

explanation.description: Detailed step-by-step HTML explanation for solution window

runtime_state_response_schema.description: The exact 'resp' / 'cloneResponse' dictionary tracked in memory during exam execution

<qid>.s: String question palette status: '0' (not visited), '1' (not answered), '2' (answered), '3' (marked for review), '4' (answered & marked)
<qid>.t: Array<{ st: 'HH:MM:SS', end: 'HH:MM:SS' }> timestamp entry and exit tracking time spent on this question
